title: customers.measurement-template-version-published.v1
description: A measurement-template version became the one measurements are captured against. A catalogue service type references the template rather than one of its versions, so publishing changes what the counter asks for without touching a catalogue row (docs/prd/measurement-templates.md section 2) and nothing downstream re-points anything. What it is published for is the other direction: a template with no published version strands every catalogue service type that points at it (INV-MTV-06), and publishing one is what heals such a breach. Catalog reconciles on it. The payload carries identifiers, a code and a version number and nothing about the fields; a consumer that needs them reads through Customers.Contracts.IMeasurementTemplateQuery, because copying a field set into an event would make every subscriber a second, stale template.
$comment: additionalProperties is true on purpose. conventions.md section 5.5 permits additive changes within a major version, so a subscriber must tolerate a field it has not seen; a closed schema would make every such addition breaking. required lists the fields present when v1 was published — a field added within v1 is optional forever, because a dead-lettered message replayed later carries the payload as it was written.

eventId.description: Identity of this occurrence. Delivery is at least once; consumers de-duplicate on it.

occurredAt.description: When the version was published, in UTC.

aggregateId.description: The template, not the version. It is what a catalogue service type's measurementTemplateId names, and ordering is preserved per template so a publication and a retirement of the same template cannot be delivered out of order.

organisationId.description: The organisation whose template it is. A reconciliation is scoped to it.

templateVersionId.description: The version that was published. A measurement pins this; a catalogue reference never does.

templateCode.description: The template's stable machine key, such as MT_BLOUSE_PATTERN. A code and not a name: it is what a seed file, an export and a message a person reads all refer to.

versionNumber.description: The version's number, for a message a person reads. A label and never a key: every reference is by identifier (docs/architecture/conventions.md section 3.1).

supersededVersionId.description: The version this one replaced, retired by the same publication, or null when it is the first version this template has published.

schemaVersion.description: The payload's major version. Agrees with the .v suffix of eventType.
